'''Springhorn''' is a leader of a pack of [[wolf|wolves]].

==Activities==
Springhorn, along with [[Three Toes]], [[Cold Water]] and [[Twilight (wolf)|Twilight]] are contacted by [[Perrin Aybara]]. He wants them to help him search for his wife, [[Faile Bashere]]. They are unable to help.{{ref/book|9|2}}
